name: NARCIST COMPLEX
original_name: ナルシスト・コンプレックス—
source:
== All Love Interests Are Narcissists! ==

Your life in a shared apartment with the self-obsessed, overconfident men who just know they're the best begins now.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8347]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
== 所有的爱情兴趣都是自恋者！==

你与自恋、过度自信的男人们住在一间公寓里，他们知道自己是最好的，你的生活从现在开始。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8347]NovelGame[/url]]
